page.layout: One page of text, no marginal notes. Running head at top centre with page number at top right. Heading in large type with number 6. Four paragraphs of running text. Catchword at lower right, gathering signature at lower left.

main_text.head: 6. De recessu Regis à Westmonasterio.
main_text.p: Quàm invitus à Westmonasterio me subduxerim, eorum esto judicium quos commeatu & armamentis destitutos Tempestas unquam compulit in altum Mare; quod tamen potius faciendum, quàm ut oram legentes, littori, cum Naufragii periculo, allidantur.

Perstiti tamen usque in Alba Aula dum pudore magis quàm metu pellerer, cùm eum barbarum furorem, & audaciam Tumultuantium cernerem, ut jam quidvis impudenter exposcerent, nullâ mihi relictâ nec ipsis Parlamenti Membris, Rationis aut Conscientiæ, libertate, quâ illis quicquam omnino nega-rcutis[?].

Unde nec mihi soli hæc Injuria illata est, quamquam mihi præcipuè intoleranda; ferre enim sècunque poterant Proceres, cæterique Depurati, (si libertate suffragandi sibi permissâ, minori postea numero vincerentur.
Eorum vero omnium concordantia suffragantium nulla Lex aut Ratio permittit, ut judicium

page.notes: The Q of the opening word is a large decorative initial, read as Quàm. Line "allidantur" is partly obscured at the line end; reconstructed from context. The end of the word "negarem" at the line end is damaged; the visible letters are given as read, with [?]. The catchword "meum" is blurred and given with [?]. "(si" is uncertain at the parenthesis. Running head Greek transcribed in Greek letters as printed. Printed "poltea" read as postea.
